facts.fact: 叙述者 Petra（孤儿院诊所医生/照护者）给孤儿 Calcy 剩下的疹斑涂 tassala 药水。
facts.anchor: I dab tassala lotion over the remaining patches of Calcy’s rash

facts.fact: Petra 把 Core 碎片埋进温室土里长出的新鲜 tassala，效力是 Ms. Opal 旧药水的 ten times more powerful，Calcy 皮肤已明显好转。
facts.anchor: the fresh tassala plant’s effects are ten times more powerful

facts.fact: 孤儿 Jasper 告诉 Petra：他和 Bort 玩时摔在石头上，划伤小臂，需要缝针。
facts.anchor: Bort and I were playing. I fell on a rock.

facts.fact: Petra 与 Flint 卖 Obscuris 烟灰缸凑到 20,000 nox，她用它买新医疗器材并给 Jasper 缝合伤口。
facts.anchor: From the 20,000 nox that Flint and I made from selling the Obscuris ashtray

facts.fact: Mr. Stone（出资雇主）给 Petra 安排 limb guy 装上顶级新手臂，机械手指替他缝针。
facts.anchor: Mr. Stone set me up with his limb guy, so my new arm is top quality.

facts.fact: Flint（Petra 男友，铁匠）下班回来（时钟 5:35 p.m.），说自己打了一把新的 Damascus steel blade。
facts.anchor: I got to make a new Damascus steel blade.

facts.fact: Flint 转述 Mr. Stone 对两人计划的评语：是好主意，但疯狂、Horribly dangerous。
facts.anchor: He thinks it’s crazy too. Horribly dangerous.

facts.fact: Petra 对 Flint 坚持 I want in. And it’s my idea too.，Flint 随即宣布要杀光 surfacewalker。
facts.anchor: We’re going to kill every last surfacewalker.
